name: dsh-obsidian-skills
description: Agent skills for Obsidian, packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle. Vendored verbatim from the official repository https://github.com/kepano/obsidian-skills (MIT, Steph Ango) — six skills covering Obsidian Flavored Markdown, Bases, JSON Canvas, the Obsidian CLI, Defuddle and Knap. Documentation only: no CLI binaries are bundled, so obsidian/defuddle/knap must be installed separately by the user.
